bio: Works on optical systems, wavefront sensing and multi-conjugate adaptive-optics instrumentation and laboratory test facilities.
long_bio: Davide works on the optical design, modelling and laboratory verification of advanced astronomical systems. His collaborations include the Ingot laser-guide-star wavefront sensor, the MATTO MCAO test bench and high-resolution optical instrumentation. This work connects optical design to practical alignment, test measurements and performance assessment.
